item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 13/Aug/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will bring heavy showers and thunderstorms to the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong today. The trough of low pressure is expected to weaken in the following couple of days and it will be brighter and hot over the region. Under the influence of another trough of low pressure, the weather over southern China will be unsettled in the middle and latter parts of this week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Lan will move towards Honshu of Japan in the next couple of days.

Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers. Showers will be heavier over some areas with thunderstorms at first. Sunny intervals during the day.
